hashConvention: Unless explicitly suffixed NormalizedLf, SHA-256 values hash raw working-copy or generated-file bytes. Installed third-party bundle hashes identify the downloaded distribution bytes. Tracked source files can have CRLF working bytes and LF Git blobs; corresponding normalized comparisons are in lock-changes.json.

installedVite.explanation: Vite bundles launch-editor and middleware internally. No standalone launch-editor addition or override is used as evidence of remediation. All marker locations refer to the installed distribution, not an unrelated package.

observations: ConfigFactory copies build.rollupOptions to build.rolldownOptions when the latter is absent; presets copy final options back for Vite 6.
Main/preload builtins and package.dependencies are externalized. build.externalizeDeps defaults true; the deprecated explicit plugin is not necessary.
Package type controls default CJS/ESM; the application explicitly configures CJS. Upstream does not unconditionally rewrite application preloadPath() to .mjs.

preloadPipeline.sourceSelection: preloadPath(): dev uses ../preload/index.js; production selects existing ../preload/index.mjs, falling back to ../preload/index.js.
preloadPipeline.format: Explicit CommonJS for main and preload. Main remains out/main/index.js; preload emits out/preload/index.js.
preloadPipeline.decision: Retain scripts/fix-preload.js and build/start/dist invocation. Correct its historical explanation: the copy preserves the application production preference; current upstream does not force every preload reference to .mjs.
preloadPipeline.verificationBoundary: Generated paths and byte equality are source/output evidence. Normal development, npm start and packaged renderer/accepted benign IPC behavior must each be executed separately; hidden bridge-presence smoke alone is insufficient.

discovery: MCP graph search found preloadPath, but get_code_snippet returned stale/unrelated lines from its different indexed checkout; current checkout source and generated outputs were read directly.
